title: cvpw assets/manifest.json
description: The provenance record for every non-code asset the film loads. An asset with no licence or no source fails the gate: a film whose provenance is unknown cannot be delivered.

id.description: Stable id. Scenes refer to assets by id, not by path, so an asset can be replaced without touching scene code.

path.description: Project-relative, forward-slashed, no absolute paths (docs/SPEC.md A5).

transparent.description: Whether the image carries an alpha channel the engine may rely on.

trimmed.description: Whether fully transparent borders were removed, which changes the registration of the asset.

registration.description: [scale, dx, dy] to place this asset onto a shared reference frame. Art spec as data, so aligning two drawings does not require re-exporting them.

landmarks.description: Named anchor points in image pixels, e.g. `{ "head": [512, 180] }`. Measurements, so a scene attaches a prop by name instead of by eyeballing a coordinate.

prompt.description: For a generated asset: the exact text that produced it, so the result is reproducible or at least auditable.

source.description: Where this came from: a URL, a tool invocation, or a person. Required.

licence.description: SPDX id or a plain statement. Required.

sha256.description: Digest of the file on disk. A mismatch is a gate failure, not a warning: it means the manifest describes a different film.

reviewed.description: Evidence that a human or agent opened this asset and judged it.
